import json
import socket


def submit_render(socket_path: str, markup: str) -> str:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as connection:
        connection.connect(socket_path)
        connection.sendall(json.dumps({"markup": markup}).encode() + b"\n")
        return json.loads(connection.makefile().readline())["job_id"]
